# Carousel (`carousel`)

Horizontal row of cards that scrolls and snaps; one card and a peek of the next on phones.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createCard` (types in `dist/web/data-display/card.d.ts`): `.mh-card`: a surface with `--mh-surface`, the panel outline, `--mh-radius-lg` and `--mh-shadow-1`. Parts `__media`, `__header` (`__icon`, `__heading` with `__eyebrow`, `__title`, `__subtitle`; `__action`), `__body`, `__footer`. Variants `--flat`, `--inset`; `--interactive` when the whole card is pressable, as a `role="button"` or, with `href`, as an `<a>`.

```ts
export function createCard(options: CardOptions = {}): CardHandle;

export interface CardOptions {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A small line above the title ("Source · 2 h ago"). */
  eyebrow?: string;
  /** Clamps the title to this many lines. */
  titleLines?: ClampLines;
  /** Small icon before the title. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** An element at the end of the header (an icon button, a badge, a switch). */
  headerAction?: HTMLElement;
  /** Edge-to-edge media at the top (an `<img>`), shown 16:9 and cropped to cover. */
  media?: HTMLElement;
  /** Width / height of the media (default 16 / 9); a wider one (2 or 2.4) keeps pictures short in a list or carousel. */
  mediaAspect?: number;
  /** Body content. */
  body?: Child | Child[];
  /** Footer content (usually buttons). */
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** `raised` (default) lifts off the canvas with `--mh-shadow-1`; `flat` has no shadow; `inset` sits in a well. */
  variant?: CardVariant;
  /** The whole card is one link (`<a href>`). Don't put other links or buttons inside. */
  href?: string;
  /** Link target; `_blank` also sets `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. */
  target?: string;
  /** The whole card is one pressable target (`role="button"`, Enter and Space); with `href`, a click listener on the link. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent) => void;
  /** Accessible name of a pressable card (default: its text). */
  label?: string;
  /** Heading level of the title (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
}

export interface CardHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The body element, to append content later. */
  body: HTMLDivElement;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setSubtitle(subtitle: string): void;
}
```

`createCarousel` (types in `dist/web/data-display/carousel.d.ts`): `.mh-carousel`: a labelled region (`aria-roledescription="carousel"`) holding a horizontally scrolling, snapping `__track` of `__slide`s (`role="group"`, `aria-roledescription="slide"`, "n of N"). On phones a slide takes most of the width so the next one peeks; the track is focusable and Arrow Left / Right move one slide. On wide screens with a fine pointer, `__nav` icon buttons step one slide and disable at the ends. When the slides don't all fit, `__dots` (one `__dot` per slide, `.is-current` for the one in view) show how many there are.

```ts
export function createCarousel(options: CarouselOptions): CarouselHandle;

export interface CarouselOptions {
  /** Required: the region's accessible name ("Search results"). */
  label: string;
  /** One element per slide; each is wrapped in a `.mh-carousel__slide`. */
  items?: HTMLElement[];
  /** Name of the previous button (default "Previous"). */
  previousLabel?: string;
  /** Name of the next button (default "Next"). */
  nextLabel?: string;
}

export interface CarouselHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** The scrolling element. */
  track: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Replaces the slides. */
  setItems(items: HTMLElement[]): void;
  /** Scrolls one slide forwards (1) or backwards (-1). */
  step(direction: CarouselDirection): void;
  /** Stops watching the track's size. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createCard, createCarousel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const stories = [
  { source: 'Riverside Courier', time: '2 h ago', title: 'Council approves a cycle path along the canal' },
  { source: 'Morning Ledger', time: '5 h ago', title: 'Local bakery wins a prize for its sourdough' },
  { source: 'Valley Weekly', time: 'Yesterday', title: 'Library extends its weekend opening hours' },
];

const carousel = createCarousel({
  label: 'News',
  items: stories.map(
    (story) =>
      createCard({
        eyebrow: `${story.source} · ${story.time}`,
        title: story.title,
        titleLines: 3,
        variant: 'flat',
        onClick: () => console.log(`Open: ${story.title}`),
      }).el,
  ),
});

document.body.append(carousel.el);
```

`Carousel` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createCarousel`: a snapping, focusable track; Arrow Left / Right step one slide.

## React example

```tsx
import { Card, Carousel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const stories = [
  { source: 'Riverside Courier', time: '2 h ago', title: 'Council approves a cycle path along the canal' },
  { source: 'Morning Ledger', time: '5 h ago', title: 'Local bakery wins a prize for its sourdough' },
  { source: 'Valley Weekly', time: 'Yesterday', title: 'Library extends its weekend opening hours' },
];

export function CarouselExample() {
  return (
    <Carousel label="News">
      {stories.map((story) => (
        <Card
          key={story.title}
          eyebrow={`${story.source} · ${story.time}`}
          title={story.title}
          titleLines={3}
          variant="flat"
          onClick={() => console.log(`Open: ${story.title}`)}
        />
      ))}
    </Carousel>
  );
}
```
